notes: 75-inch 4K UHD (3840x2160) Android smart signage display; desktop/wall-mount (VESA 600x400) unit, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Data pulled from BenQ's official datasheet PDF (dated 20.07.2022, distributed via BenQ Deutschland/Bechtle), cross-checked against BenQ AU/EU regional spec pages and an authorized reseller (Avendor) listing, all of which agree. Built-in 10W x2 loudspeakers are internal (not a physical port) and are omitted from the port list. RS232 and IR are each listed by BenQ as having both an input and a loop-through output; both directions are included as separate ports per the datasheet's "Input Control" and "Output Control" sections. Power inlet is a detachable IEC cord per BenQ's ST-series manual conventions (datasheet lists "Power supply: Internal" and includes a Power-Cable in the scope of supply; exact IEC sub-type (C13/C14) not stated on the datasheet itself, inferred from standard BenQ large-format display practice). No grade-eligible connector had its version omitted: HDMI ports are explicitly stated as HDMI 2.0; VGA, DVI, USB-A 2.0, RJ45 (10/100 = eth-100m), RS232, IR, and audio jacks are graded/labeled per the schema rules (Ethernet graded eth-100m since datasheet states 10/100 Mbps; USB-A graded usb-2.0 since explicitly stated as USB 2.0). DVI input's exact sub-type (DVI-D single-link vs dual-link) is not specified by BenQ; assumed DVI-D (typical for signage displays) and mapped to the closest schema id "dvi".
